title: Fix SmartEdge accessing full nodes array causing re-renders
description: CRITICAL PERFORMANCE: The SmartEdge component (src/components/canvas/smart-edge.tsx line 43) uses `const nodes = useGraphStore((s) => s.nodes)` which subscribes to the FULL nodes array. Per React Flow official performance guide (reactflow.dev/learn/advanced-use/performance): 'One of the most common performance pitfalls in React Flow is directly accessing the nodes or edges in the components.' Every node drag/position change triggers re-render of ALL SmartEdge instances, which each perform expensive obstruction detection + path computation. Fix: Use `useReactFlow().getNodes()` only at render time (already imported but used incorrectly via `void getNodes`), or better yet pass nodes as a parameter via useStoreApi to access on-demand rather than subscribing. The `getObstructingNodes` call should use the imperative getNodes() to compute the path without subscribing to every node change. SOLID violation: Dependency Inversion — edge component directly depends on mutable shared state it doesn't need to subscribe to.
